title: No live prices stored, a revision lock, insert-only history, not-live legs never priced (row 16 match line)
reference_behaviour: No such guards are visible: a save overwrites the record and nothing marks a leg whose contract is no longer live.
ours: REQ-038 AC-5 refuses live fields; updates need the expected revision; history rows are insert-only; a not-live leg shows its reason and is never priced. Kept as stricter safety, ADR-152 exception (a).
